note: Working rate card for labelled estimates. Not billed usage. Not Origin licence pricing. Update when the source page changes.
chars_per_token_note: Industry rule of thumb (bytes/4). Not a vendor tokenizer. Label every token figure as estimated.

model.source_note: Official table row Claude Sonnet 4.6, Base Input Tokens $3 / MTok, retrieved 2026-09-04. Input-only for dump vs query (the extra context is the input). Output is not modelled.

labour.usd_per_hour_note: Working assumption for a senior product engineer, not a 2one wage study.
labour.cycle_note: One generation cycle = produce a screen, then review. Without the product: read the output and restyle by eye. With the product: run npx 2one check and graph:decide, then fix what they name. These minutes are assumptions until a time-and-motion study exists.

scale.scale_note: Headline labour and API $ are per 100 generation cycles so a single-query figure is not mistaken for a contract value.
